style.proportion: chibi, about 2.5 heads tall: the oversized hood/head is roughly 40% of the total height, short thick legs, large gloved hands, big chunky boots, a weapon that is nearly as long as the torso
style.rendering: clean dark-brown outline of uniform weight, flat cel shading with a few soft gradient highlights, chunky simplified faceted shapes, muted warm palette with one strong accent colour, subtle metallic trim in tan/gold
style.composition: single character, full body, standing, slight three-quarter front view, weapon held low in front, plain off-white (#EFEBE4) background with a faint ground shadow, portrait 3:4 canvas, no text, no frame

characters.name: 魔法使い
characters.description: a young mage in a tall pointed indigo hat with a gold star emblem, oversized sleeves, a short purple cape, round spectacles-like glowing cyan eyes in the shadow of the hat, holding a crooked wooden staff topped with a glowing crystal

characters.name: 弓使い
characters.description: a ranger with a green hood and feathered cap, a leaf-green scarf, leather vest and bracers, a quiver on the back, glowing amber eyes under the hood, holding a big recurve bow with an arrow nocked

characters.name: 僧侶
characters.description: a gentle healer in a white and gold mitre-like hood, long white robe with teal trim, a small round shield on the arm, soft glowing pink eyes, holding a heavy mace shaped like a golden sun

characters.name: 忍者
characters.description: a ninja in a dark navy hood with a metal forehead plate, a long red scarf flowing behind, light armour plates on shoulders and shins, glowing white eyes, holding a short kunai-like blade in a reverse grip

characters.name: 竜騎士
characters.description: a heavy knight with a horned dragon-scale helmet in dark crimson and bronze, a big shoulder pauldron shaped like a dragon head, glowing orange eyes in the visor shadow, holding an oversized lance with a flag

characters.name: 錬金術師
characters.description: an alchemist in a goggled brown hood, a stained apron with many pouches and glass vials on the belt, thick rubber gloves, glowing lime-green eyes, holding a bubbling flask in one hand and a wrench in the other

characters.name: ロボ兵
characters.description: a small steel guard robot with a dome helmet hood, a single glowing yellow visor slit, riveted plates, a tattered blue cloak, holding a big rectangular tower shield and a short sword

characters.name: 海賊
characters.description: a pirate in a big black tricorn hat with a skull emblem pulled low over a shadowed face, glowing red eyes, a teal coat with brass buttons, a sash, holding an oversized cutlass
